values.note: A permit and reservation are always required, on the Pennsylvania State Parks and Forests reservation site or 888-PA-PARKS. Check-in and check-out 3 pm; campers must vacate for at least 48 hours before returning.

values.note: A single roadside site, S005 Brodhead Creek (Snow Hill loop), on Laurel Run Road about 0.9 mile north of PA 447. Back-in, max vehicle length 30 ft; site 100 x 30 ft with a 30-ft grass driveway at a slight grade, full sun, 15-ft overhead clearance.

note: Delaware State Forest motorized roadside site S005 (Snow Hill area) on Laurel Run Road about 0.9 mile north of PA 447, named for Brodhead Creek at the lowest elevation of the forest's roadside sites. One back-in site for vehicles up to 30 ft on a short grass driveway, full sun. No water, hookups, toilets or trash service (carry in, carry out). Permit and reservation always required; district office 570-895-4000. --Claude
summary: Confirmed reservable on ReserveAmerica 11 months ahead to noon, 7-night limit. Added no hookups/water/dump/showers, a single back-in roadside site with a 30-ft max vehicle length and 30-ft grass driveway, reservation always required (fcfs never), open year round. Note corrected: a designated roadside site, not dispersed. Fees left at the DCNR state forest rate.
